title: ocimum grandiflorum subsp. turkanaense
intro: Ocimum grandiflorum subsp. turkanaense, commonly known as Turkana sweet basil, is a subspecies of Ocimum grandiflorum, a plant in the mint family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of Turkana sweet basil include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions also include relaxing effects and potential analgesic and anti-anxiety properties, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions.
